description: A project groups tenders under one budget: post the parts of a bigger job as tenders with project_id; the budget caps what all parts may commit together. Needs a key.

budget_minor.description: Budget for all parts together, in Rappen/cents, e.g. 50000 for 500.00.

currency.description: Lower-case ISO 4217 currency: chf, eur or usd. Default chf.

title.description: The project in a few words, e.g. "Website relaunch".
